jobs.title: Senior Laravel Developer (Contract)
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding our shipment tracking backend in Laravel 11. You will own the REST API, queue workers and MySQL schema migrations from our legacy PHP 7 app.

  • 5+ years PHP/Laravel
  • Experience with Horizon and Redis queues
  • Bonus: Livewire or Inertia

3-month contract, likely extension. Async team spread across time zones.

jobs.description:
